subject.title: WhatsApp group messages never reach inbound handling (LID groups?) — DMs work; repro across relink + 2026.6.11→2026.7.1

question: Should the WhatsApp plugin switch to a Desktop companion identity and require an explicit re-pair recovery path for legacy `openclaw/cli` sessions, or preserve existing pairings while pursuing a different upstream-compatible fix?
rationale: The likely runtime fix changes the identity registered at pairing time; applying it unconditionally can stop existing sessions, while preserving the old identity leaves affected group ingestion broken.

options.title: Switch with re-pair recovery
options.body: Use the Desktop identity for the supported session path and add a clear Doctor/setup diagnostic that guides legacy users through logout and QR re-pairing.

options.title: Preserve legacy identity
options.body: Keep the current pairing identity until an alternative Baileys or WhatsApp mechanism restores group push without invalidating existing sessions.

recommendation.title: Switch with re-pair recovery
recommendation.body: Use the Desktop identity for the supported session path and add a clear Doctor/setup diagnostic that guides legacy users through logout and QR re-pairing.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work owns reconnect group hydration in the exact socket lifecycle where the identity and upgrade behavior must be reconciled.
